operation: Code-only timing, positioning, animation playback and alpha changes. Reuses supplied textures without creating or altering any media.

activation.outline: Starts on native heatActivationStarted and equivalent remote observer activation, before mode fuel. Restored on interruption/end.
activation.rendering: Detached world sprites, normal alpha, outward drift/upward lift/expansion; pause-aware, one shot per activation.
activation.tint: Same ColorInfo/RGB (.25,.15,1) as Extreme Heat flames, for both activation and sustained smoke.

taunt.trigger: Successful taunt completion only, including replicated completion.
taunt.rendering: The existing three HeatWisp sequences and four-emitter normal aura layout, normal transparency and normal playback speed. Replaces the normal body pass during the echo; no old flare/sparks, no additive pulse. Existing blue pixels retained; a 25-percent-whiter copy requires user approval.
taunt.pause: Lifetime and animation pause; cancellation has no echo.
